label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_01
text: I will return later when it is time for the young\nmaster’s piano lesson.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_02
text: Until then, please give him my regards.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_01
text: Y-yes, Mr. Harrington![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_04
text: And who might you be, young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady? A friend of\nthe young master, perhaps?[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_select_01
text: “Young master”?

label: ajito_fairy_010_select_02
text: Errr... I’m not sure!

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_05
text: Ah. I see...[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_06
text: Since you seem unaware, I must inform you that\nthis is the base of Team Star’s Fairy crew—the\r\nRuchbah Squad led by young Master Ortega.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_02
text: Um, Mr. Harrington? I don’t think we’re supposed\nto be giving out that information...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_07
text: No? Then please accept my apologies.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_08
text: Do you have any idea as to who this young [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0403)]manlady\nmight be?[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_03
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s no friend of ours. Y’know, I think [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she might\nbe here to try and take us on![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_09
text: Understood. In that case...I take it you’re an\nadversary of the young master?[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_select_03
text: Yup, that’s right!

label: ajito_fairy_010_select_04
text: I...guess that follows?

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_10
text: Is that so. Well then, that leaves me with one last\nthing to ask you...[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_11
text: Would you be so kind as to indulge me in a\nquick battle?[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_12
text: Ah, yes, I suppose you must need to prepare.\nI will wait until you have your affairs in order.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_13
text: Splendid. Then let us begin.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_14
text: An outstanding performance.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_15
text: However. Be aware that young Master Ortega’s\nbattle prowess far surpasses my paltry skills.\r\nYou would do well to take care.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_jentle_16
text: Now, if you’ll excuse me.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_05
text: H-hasta la vistar... ☆[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_06
text:
That gentlemanly guy used to be the director of
the academy...I think? Least, that’s what I heard.\c
Now he’s, like, tutoring the boss or something.
He shows up here sometimes to take the boss
to his lessons...[VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_07
text: Hang on—why am I explaining this to you?![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_08
text: There’s no doubting you’re here to make trouble,\nso I gotta go let everyone know![VAR 0x0114(002F)]

label: ajito_fairy_010_sitappa_09
text: Hasta la vistaaar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002F)]
